import csv,h5py,collections
src_sets=collections.defaultdict(set)
src_info={}
with open('source_meta.csv',newline='') as f:
 for r in csv.DictReader(f):
  sid=r['SampleID']; cell=r['Cells']; pref=sid+'_'
  bc=cell[len(pref):] if cell.startswith(pref) else cell.rsplit('_',1)[-1]
  src_sets[sid].add(bc)
  src_info[sid]=(r['Tissue'],r['Disease'],r['PatientID'])
with h5py.File('lung.cancer.sc.h5ad','r') as f:
 idx=[x.decode() for x in f['obs/_index'][:]]
 cats=[x.decode() for x in f['obs/sampleID/categories'][:]]
 codes=f['obs/sampleID/codes'][:]
our=collections.defaultdict(set)
for cell,code in zip(idx,codes):
 p=cats[int(code)]
 our[p].add(cell[len(p)+1:])
for p in cats:
 a=our[p]
 scores=[]
 for sid,b in src_sets.items():
  inter=len(a&b)
  if inter: scores.append((inter, inter/len(a), inter/len(b),sid,len(a),len(b),src_info[sid]))
 scores.sort(reverse=True)
 print(p, scores[:3])

import csv,h5py,collections
# mapping exact sample source to anonymized using original prefix recovery from first source order; create lookup
src_by_cell={}
sample_info={}
with open('source_meta.csv',newline='') as f:
 for r in csv.DictReader(f):
  src_by_cell[r['Cells']]=r
  sample_info[r['SampleID']]=(r['Tissue'],r['Disease'],r['PatientID'])
# exact mapping can use prefix and barcode, infer source prefix candidates via source rows grouped; known mapping from order/use sets as before
# construct barcode tuple lookup lists and identify exact source sample from cell count + barcode set fingerprint
src_rows=collections.defaultdict(dict)
with open('source_meta.csv',newline='') as f:
 for r in csv.DictReader(f):
  sid=r['SampleID']; bc=r['Cells'][len(sid)+1:]
  src_rows[sid][bc]=r
with h5py.File('lung.cancer.sc.h5ad','r') as f:
 idx=[x.decode() for x in f['obs/_index'][:]]
 cats=[x.decode() for x in f['obs/sampleID/categories'][:]]
 codes=f['obs/sampleID/codes'][:]
our_bcs=collections.defaultdict(list)
for cell,code in zip(idx,codes):
 p=cats[int(code)]; our_bcs[p].append(cell[len(p)+1:])
map_sid={}
for p,bcs in our_bcs.items():
 aset=set(bcs); exact=[]
 for sid,d in src_rows.items():
  if len(d)==len(bcs) and aset==set(d): exact.append(sid)
 if len(exact)"'!=1:
  # ties from near duplicated libraries resolved by full exact cell count set usually; print
  print('"'mapping issue',p,exact)
 else: map_sid[p]=exact[0]
immune={'B','CD4','CD8','DC','Gran','Mast','Mo','NK','Tregs'}
nonimmune={'ATI','ATII','Basal','Cilia','Club','EC','Fib','NE'}
ct=collections.Counter(); per=collections.defaultdict(collections.Counter)
for p,bcs in our_bcs.items():
 sid=map_sid[p]
 for bc in bcs:
  r=src_rows[sid][bc]
  cell=r['CellName']; dis=r['Disease']; tissue=r['Tissue']
  ct[(cell,dis,tissue)]+=1; per[p][cell]+=1
for p in ['Patient_005','Patient_006','Patient_007','Patient_018','Patient_040']:
 sid=map_sid[p]; inf=sample_info[sid]
 print(p,sid,inf,'n',sum(per[p].values()),'DC',per[p]['DC'],'prop',per[p]['DC']/sum(per[p].values()),'cells',per[p])
all_non=sum(n for (cell,dis,t),n in ct.items() if cell in nonimmune)
lusc_basal=sum(n for (cell,dis,t),n in ct.items() if cell=='Basal' and dis=='LUSC')
lusc_basal_tumor=sum(n for (cell,dis,t),n in ct.items() if cell=='Basal' and dis=='LUSC' and t=='Tumor')
print('all_non',all_non,'lusc_basal',lusc_basal,lusc_basal/all_non*100,'lusc_basal_tumor',lusc_basal_tumor,lusc_basal_tumor/all_non*100)
print('nonimmune breakdown', {c:sum(n for (cell,dis,t),n in ct.items() if cell==c) for c in sorted(nonimmune)})
print('disease/tissue',collections.Counter((sample_info[map_sid[p]][0],sample_info[map_sid[p]][1]) for p in cats))
